rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>We too were born with power of our own.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Frost brothers' confession begins here (confirmed by 09896's 'Category F', matching later 09975-09982 narration).

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>But that power wasn't compatible
with the Flash System.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Flash System per encyclopedia_022.json / ui_028.json locked spelling.

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>We were labeled Category F,
and never recognized as Newtypes.<ab(500)>
rows.notes: 'Category F' confirmed against Gundam Wiki (Olba Frost article): Frost brothers' Twins Synchronization was not sensitive to the Flash System, so UNE classified them Category F. See glossary proposals file. No <ed()> in source; box continues into 09897.

rows.target: <sp(20)>And the world simply pretended we didn't exist.<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.notes: Continues the box from 09896.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>Is that your reason for trying to change the world?!<ab(300)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>You couldn't possibly understand...<ab(300)>
rows.notes: No <ed()> in source; box continues into 09900.

rows.target:
<sp(20)>...the agony of holding power beyond human limits,
yet never being recognized for it.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Continues the box from 09899.

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>The humiliation we endured... and the despair...
can only be healed by this world's destruction.<ab(500)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>And only after everything is destroyed
will a new order be built.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>That's the righteous future we seek.<ab(500)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>A selfish reason like that...!
Like hell I'll accept it!!<ab(500)>
rows.notes: No <ed()> in source; box continues into 09905-09907. New speaker (protests the brothers' ideology); identity not supplied since source gives none.

rows.target: <sp(20)>I won't accept the likes of you!!<ab(300)>
rows.notes: Continues the box from 09904.

rows.target:
<sp(20)>Everyone carries pain and sorrow
and keeps on living!!<ab(500)>
rows.notes: Continues the box from 09905.

rows.target:
<sp(20)>I won't let you destroy the world
over some selfish reason like that!!<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.notes: Closes the box begun at 09904.

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>What would someone like you know?!
About this suffering of ours!!<ab(500)><ed()>

<sp(20)>I won't let you destroy the world
over some selfish reason like that!!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Source repeats the exact same line as 09907 verbatim (own box, no <op()>); translated identically rather than varied, per source repetition.

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>Because the world ignored us,
we will destroy the world!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>If only you two would touch D.O.M.E. as well...!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Conditional/suggestive form ('触れれば') kept as a wish rather than a command; addressee ('you two') inferred from the immediate Frost-brothers exchange, not from an explicit tag.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>There's no need for that.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>We need you to intercept them.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Register shift to a combat order suggests a new speaker/context; no identity invented.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>Enemy reinforcements!<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>More enemy units incoming!<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Enemy reinforcements incoming! Stay alert!<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.notes: Source uses a full-width ideographic space as separator; rendered as a normal ASCII space/sentence break, no fullwidth punctuation carried into the target.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>New enemy ship confirmed!<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>An enemy ship has appeared!<ab(800)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>There's no operation time left!
Hurry!<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.notes: Matches corpus precedent verbatim (batch_01586 dialogue_01586-adjacent 'There's no operation time left! Hurry!').

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>You've come a long way to get here,
Tiffa Adill.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Full name 'Tiffa Adill' per character_names_021.json locked spelling, used here since the source spells out the full name (D.O.M.E. addressing her formally).

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>Because everyone came to understand...<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Though it seems some people refused, too.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Yes...
They want war more than they want the truth.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>War, huh...
People never tire of it, do they.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Those who worship Newtypes like gods.
Those who'd seal them away and use their power.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Those who once held that power themselves.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Everyone grasps the word Newtype
in their own way.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: No quotation marks added; source has none here (contrast 09963, which uses corner brackets in source).

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>And that's about to become
the trigger for yet another war.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>But in a way,
maybe that's unavoidable.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>After all, we're a generation bound together
by the illusion called Newtype.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Are you saying Newtypes are an illusion...!?<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Isn't this power itself humanity's evolution...?
Isn't that what's called the power of a Newtype?<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>I understand wanting to believe that,
but unfortunately, that's not it.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Power beyond human limits and humanity's evolution
are two different things.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>...Then give me an answer.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>I fought believing
that I was a Newtype.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>And I saw beyond time. I felt the future.
Are you saying all of that was an illusion?<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Source uses a full-width ideographic space between the two sentences on the first line; rendered as a normal ASCII space.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>That's right... all of it was an illusion.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>No matter what future you saw,
unless you try to make it real...<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>...it will never be yours.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>The age of wandering in search of Newtypes
is already over.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>And you're the ones who have to go
and build a new future.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>A new future...<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>You've been troubled by your own power, haven't you.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Addressee is Tiffa, confirmed by her reply at 09945.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Yes... I want to live as an ordinary person,
with Garrod.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Speaker is Tiffa; both named parties (Tiffa implicitly, Garrod explicitly) are in the source text itself.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Then simply cast aside the word Newtype.
That should grant your wish.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: No quotation marks added; source has none here.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>You've fought this whole time believing in the future.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>That's exactly the power that will build a new era.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>One more thing...
I have to tell you.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>The Command Cluster, the core of the Scub Coral,
is about to be destroyed.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Command Cluster / Scub Coral per ui_028.json and dialogs_options_018.json locked spellings; no book() tags in source here, so none added.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>By the hand of someone named Dewey.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Dewey (Novak) per character_names_021.json locked spelling; only the given name appears in source.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>If that happens, the Limit of Questions
will come.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: 'Limit of Questions' per encyclopedia_021_b.json / encyclopedia_022.json locked spelling (クダンの限界).

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>The only way to avoid it
is for the Scub Coral and humanity to merge.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>What happens then?<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Every being becomes one and the same,
surviving on as consciousness alone.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>What do you think? Tiffa.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>...As people, we want to live
acknowledging each other's separate existence.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Speaker is Tiffa (reply to 09956).

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>I understand.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>I'll tell the Command Cluster to wait for you.
The rest is up to you.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>You're going to enter the Zone.
That's where the Scub is waiting for the moment of dialogue.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: 'the Zone' matches corpus convention (mission_terms_019.json, batch_03803); no book() tag here since source has none. 'Scub' (short form) matches batch_05943 precedent/proposal for book(69).

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>There...
you'll come to know the world's other face.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>That's everything I can tell you.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>No one in this world truly deserves
to be called a "Newtype."<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Quotation marks used here because the source itself marks the word with corner brackets (『Newtype』); ASCII straight quotes used per format rules.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>And I'll be returning to where I came from, too.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>The old age is already over...<ab(500)><off()>

rows.notes: Speaker addresses 'brother' directly; per character_names_021.json note, Olba addresses Shagia as 'brother' (兄さん), matching this line and the 09970-09971 exchange, but no name is written into the target text itself.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>...We have no more business with the New Federation.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Glory to our world!<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Course clear.
Advancing toward the designated point.<ab(500)><off()>

rows.notes: Olba per character_names_021.json locked spelling (Olba Frost).

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>Brother!!<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Reply to 09970; per character_names_021.json, Olba addresses Shagia as 'brother', consistent with this exchange.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>What <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()> told us...
Build the future, huh... Let's do our best.
rows.notes: No ab()/ed()/off() in source (matches 09973-09991's tail pattern); none added.
